craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as non-dual identity; two-step recognition (grace-showing → identity-declaring). Sanskrit-first: avaśeṣam (WITHOUT REMAINDER — kept; totality is the doctrine); tavaiva/tvayā (instrumental twice — means and end both Him). Rows: 3 (Yours/mine chiasmus — ‘become Yours…all is mine through You’: tvadīya/madīya interlock kept), 7 (Maheśa-vocative mid-L2 — identity declared TO him), 1 (‘through You’ closes — the hinge last). Close: ‘all is mine through You’. Rupture: ‘You, Maheśa, are ever my own self’ (showing turns to declaring — appearance, then ownership per C1). Rejected: ‘by Your grace’ smoothing — killed: grace-POWER (śakti) kept as power; ‘everything is mine’ — killed: dropping ‘through You’ drops non-duality's ground; ‘now I see’ for ‘appears to me’ — killed: bhāti (appears/shines) kept impersonal. Read aloud: ALL-this, be-COME-yours with-OUT re-MAIN-der … YOU, ma-HE-śa, are EV-er MY-own-SELF — MADE-of-you, ALL is MINE through-YOU.

lines: All this, become Yours without remainder, now appears to me by the power of Your grace.
You, Maheśa, are ever my own self — made of You, all is mine through You.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvanmayam etad aśeṣam idānīṃ bhāti mama tvadanugrahaśaktyā tvaṃ ca maheśa sadaiva mamātmā svātmamayaṃ mama tena samastam
notes: svātmamaya kept constitutive (‘made of You’), not identity — see NOTE boundary

reads_against.argmap: How does the world appear as His, and how is identity declared? → Recognition is two-step, not one.
c1_essence: Grace first discloses the world as His, without remainder, now — then identity is declared outright: Maheśa, always my self, and all mine through Him.
Appearance, then ownership: grace showing the world as His before identity claims it.
The non-dual recognition (pratyabhijñā) is here performed as a two-step: disclosure, then declaration.
